description: This file defines the SalahHistoryActivity class which manages the display of prayer history within an Android application. It initializes UI components such as a RecyclerView and interacts with SalahRepository to fetch and display prayer history data.

classes.name: SalahHistoryActivity
classes.description: An Android activity responsible for displaying the history of Salah prayers using a RecyclerView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that sets up the activity UI, initializes the SalahRepository and adapter, and binds data to the RecyclerView.
